decision.title: +−=÷× (Tour Collection)
tracklist: You Need Me, I Don't Need You
Lay It All on Me (with Rudimental)

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (24 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%2B%E2%88%92%3D%C3%B7%C3%97_(Tour_Collection), https://www.discogs.com/release/31843265-Ed-Sheeran---Tour-Collection. Greatest hits compilation released 27 September 2024 (Asylum/Atlantic), spanning the five math-symbol albums + - = ÷ × plus collaborations-era singles. DIGITAL/STREAMING EDITION listed here (24 tracks). Wikipedia's standard track listing marks tracks 2 ('You Need Me, I Don't Need You') and 12 ('Lay It All on Me (with Rudimental)') as digital/streaming-only [note b]. The physical CD/vinyl edition is 22 tracks: identical list minus tracks 2 and 12 (confirmed by Discogs CD r31843265, Discogs vinyl r32696685, Muziker, Ireland Vinyl). Also note the Japanese edition adds 'Celestial' and a Christmas edition adds 'Merry Christmas' (with Elton John); a separate '+−=÷× (Tour Collection: Live)' release (Dec 2024) is a different 2-disc live set, NOT this release.
